title: 汽車軟體更新管理
summary: 從版本發布者到車主角色走過下載、簽章驗證、切換及回復，區分雜湊與可信發布者身分。
summaryEn: Follow release-to-owner download, signature verification, activation and recovery, distinguishing hashing from publisher authentication.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 軟體下載時長：機制與觀察
steps.objective: 辨識 軟體下載時長 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Software-download duration and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為更新映像、信任鏈、A/B槽與開機證據。以十進位MB計算理想傳輸時間；驗證、安裝與重啟屬不同階段。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows update images, trust chain, a/b slots and boot evidence. Decimal MB gives ideal transfer duration; verification, installation and reboot are separate phases.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：t=8 size/rate；size=200 MB、rate=20 Mbit/s；計算結果=80 s。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: t=8 size/rate; size=200 MB, rate=20 Mbit/s; result=80 s.
steps.failure: 只驗雜湊而沒有可信簽章無法確認發布者；保存授權信任鏈與版本政策。
steps.failureEn: A hash alone does not authenticate the publisher; retain the trusted signature chain and version policy.
steps.check: 理想80 s；不可把下載完成當更新成功，還要驗證開機版本與功能。 將此判讀連回更新映像、信任鏈、A/B槽與開機證據的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Ideal duration is 80 s; download completion is not update success without boot-version and functional checks. Relate this interpretation to update images, trust chain, a/b slots and boot evidence and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
